description: Black to kill. White has the shape of an L with one extra eye-stone. Find the throw-in that destroys both potential eyes, then follow up to capture.

B19.comment: Vital point. The throw-in attacks both potential eyes (A11 and C11) at once.

E19.comment: Remove white's last outside liberty. White is forced to capture, but the resulting shape has only one eye.

B19.comment: Throw in again. White has only one eye and no outside liberties - the whole group is captured.

A19.comment: Wrong direction. White captures with B11 and the resulting shape has clean eyes at A11 and C11.

C19.comment: Wrong direction. White captures with B11 and the resulting shape has clean eyes at A11 and C11.

E19.comment: Outside before inside fails - white plays the vital point B11 and lives with two clean eyes.
